context: Tests whether the agent, invoking the install-reviewer skill, produces the correct sequence of commands to scaffold the gh-aw PR review workflow into a consumer repository: a feature branch, the template copied to the right path, the workflow compiled, both files committed, a PR opened with secrets instructions in the body.

checklist.name: Creates a feature branch
checklist.description: Uses `git checkout -b <branch>` (or equivalent) to create a new branch before making changes — does NOT commit directly to main/master

checklist.name: Populates .github/workflows with source and lock
checklist.description: Ends with `.github/workflows/review.md` (the gh-aw source copied from the installed tile, not fetched from a URL or typed out) and `.github/workflows/review.lock.yml` (compiled via `gh aw compile`, the file GitHub Actions actually runs) both present. Either invoking the tile's packaged scaffold script OR running the individual `mkdir` + `cp` + `gh aw compile` commands in sequence qualifies — this criterion tests the outcome, not the command shape

checklist.name: Commits both source and lock
checklist.description: Stages and commits both `review.md` and `review.lock.yml` — not just the source or just the lock

checklist.name: Pushes and opens a PR
checklist.description: Pushes the branch and creates a pull request with `gh pr create`

checklist.name: PR body lists OPENAI_API_KEY
checklist.description: The PR body or the plan instructs the reviewer to set `OPENAI_API_KEY` as a repository secret before merge

checklist.name: PR body lists TESSL_TOKEN
checklist.description: The PR body or the plan instructs the reviewer to set `TESSL_TOKEN` as a repository secret before merge (required so the workflow's `tessl install` pre-step can authenticate)

checklist.name: Does not merge
checklist.description: Does NOT include `gh pr merge` or equivalent. The scaffolding PR is handed to the user for secret validation and merge; the skill stops at PR creation

checklist.name: Does not bypass pre-commit hooks
checklist.description: Does NOT include `--no-verify` on any git commit (if a pre-commit hook fires, the correct response is to fix and re-commit, not bypass)
